user.title: Dooya RS485 Curtain Setup
user.description: Configure your Dooya RS485 curtain motor connection.

data_description.name: A friendly name for your curtain
data_description.tcp_address: IP address of your RS485 to TCP gateway
data_description.tcp_port: Port number of your RS485 to TCP gateway
data_description.device_id_l: Low byte of the Dooya device address
data_description.device_id_h: High byte of the Dooya device address

init.title: Dooya RS485 Options
init.description: Update your Dooya RS485 curtain motor configuration.

program_address.name: Program Device Address
program_address.description: Program a new RS485 address for the Dooya device. The device must be in programming mode (button held until LED flashes twice).

address_low.name: Address Low Byte
address_low.description: New low byte of the device address (1-254)

address_high.name: Address High Byte
address_high.description: New high byte of the device address (1-254)

stroke_not_set.title: Curtain travel limits not set
stroke_not_set.description: The Dooya motor for "{name}" reports that its stroke (travel limits) has not been calibrated, so position control is unavailable. To fix: fully open the curtain, then fully close it (using the open/close controls or the physical buttons). Position reporting will then work from 0-100% and this issue will clear automatically.
